system.description: Roll a Finesse check to pickpocket an unequipped item from an adjacent target's inventory.

Inflicts -1 Agi and -1 Tqn for 1 turn per hit.

Inflicts Slashing damage when in melee range, and Missile damage when thrown.

You make yourself less of a presence on the battlefield, gaining the 'Sneak' status effect. While Sneaking, enemies will not target you unless there are no other valid targets in their range. You may move through hostile units, and they may move through you as well.

This effect persists until you take a hostile action or become the target of a hostile action. Using this ability again while sneaking will also end the effect.

At the start of each of this unit's turns, it gains the 'Uncanny Dodge' status effect. This effect raises their Eva and Agi saving throw bonus by 4. They lose this effect after the first attack made against them, or after the first Agi saving throw they are compelled to roll.
You have the ability to dismantle locks and traps.
Protected from Shadow damage. Vulnerable to Missile and Wind damage.
